Work experience certificate from private individual shall not be accepted. Notes: The bidder shall submit details of work executed by them in the prescrib ed format along with bid for the service contracts to be considered for qualification of work experience criteria clearly indicating the nature/scope of co ntract, actual completion cost and actual date of completion for such contract. 2.6.1.2 Financial Standing:- The Bidders will be qualified only if they have m inimum financial capabilities as below — (i) T1 – Financial Turnover :- The bidder should have an aggregate financial t urnover not less than 1.5 times the advertised Bid value during the last three pr evious financial years and in the current financial year upto the date of opening of the tender . The audited balance sheet reflecting financial turnover certified by chartered accountant with her stamp, signature and membership number sh all be considered. (ii) T2- Liquidity: The bidder should have access to or have available liquid as sets, lines of credit and other financial means to meet cash flow that is valued a t 5% of the estimated bid value net of applicant's commitments for other contra cts. The audited balance sheet and/or banking reference certified by chartered accountant with his/her stamp, signature and membership number shall be sub

mitted by the bidder along with bid. Banking reference should contain in clear terms the amount that bank will be in a position to lend for this work to the applicant/member of the Joint Venture/Con sortium. In case the Net Current Assets (as seen from the Balance Sheets) are n egative, only the Banking references will be considered. Otherwise the aggregat e of the Net Current Assets and submitted Banking references will be considere d for working out the Liquidity. The banking reference should be from a Schedul ed Bank in India and it should not be more than 3 months old as on date of sub mission of bids. In Case of JV firms overall liquidity of JV firm shall be assessed b y arithmetic sum of liquidity of all members of JV. Buyer Added Conditions :- 1. Availability of Vehicles : - The Bidder is required to submit the supporting documents / RC of minimum Four SUV vehicles as required in this Bid or higher version model having manufacture year not older than 2024 either registered in the name of bidder/Firm, or the bidder should have a MOU (Memorandum of Un derstanding) with the owner of the vehicle for the proposed hiring with Railway. The MOU date must be on or after Bid publishing date. Evidence of at least F our such vehicles must be attached along with the original Bid Docume nt, otherwise offer shall be summarily rejected. 2. Availability of office of service provider : Office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. Documentary evidence for the office has to be submitted with offer containing the office address details. Request of f irm to open office in the state of consignee after award of contract will not be e ntertained. 3. Bidder’s Financial Standing :- The Bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upl oad undertaking to this effect with the Bid. 4. Self certified Undertaking as per annexure “I" to the effect that all the documents submitted by him/her along with his/her bid are true. T his is mandatory and the bid shall be summarily rejected if the bidder f ails to submit this undertaking along with the bid. 5. Declaration as per Annexure “II” regarding Employment / Partnershi p/Relatives employed in Gazetted capacity etc. of Retired Railway emp loyee needs to be submitted along with the Bid, without submission of Annexure II, bids shall be summarily rejected. 6. Each page of the copy of documents / certificates in support of credentials, su bmitted by the bidder, shall be self-attested by the bidder or authorized represe ntative of the bidding firm. Self-attestation shall include signature, stamp and d ate (on each page). Only, those documents will be considered for evaluating bid

, which are duly self-attested as above. 7. The following duly filled 'Annexure'/documents are to be submitted by the Bidder along with the Bid. a) Work experience certificate issued by concerned department/employer/client , preferably as per ‘Annexure V’. b) Certificate of contractual receipts as per ‘Annexure VI’ issued by Chartered Accountant (for T-1 financial criteria). c) Banking reference (if required) issued by bank (for T-2 financial criteria). d) Net current assets issued by Chartered Accountant / company auditor for ascertaining liquidity (for T-2 financial criteria). e) Audited balance sheets issued by Chartered Accountant (For current financial year and last three financial years). 8. During representation, only clarification on bid documents/quoted terms & co nditions will be accepted. No any documents will be accepted during representa tion after opening of Bid. 9. In case of any contradiction, Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC will supersede in t erms of minimum eligibility criteria and other conditions mentioned in GeM GTC . 10. Railway will be at liberty to terminate the contract with the service provider if he fails to provide the vehicle as required as per conditions within 7 days of is suance of Acceptance letter. Additional terms and conditions :- 1. The vehicle provided on hire should be in good condition having model manu facture year not older than 2024. It should be registered in the name of Bidder/ Firm, or the bidder should have an MOU (Memorandum of Understanding) with t he owner of the vehicle.

The vehicle provided shall be one out of the three models mentioned i n the Bid or any other equivalent or higher version model as per GeM li st of SUV vehicles with consent of the user officer. 2. Necessary charges like night halt outstation, extra KM running, extra hours ru nning will be paid additionally as per GeM SLA. 3. Penalties for defaults like late reporting, non-reporting; refusal, bad condition of vehicle, etc. will be imposed as per SLA General conditions. 4. Penalty provision for non-deployment of vehicle by the competent authority S.N. Note : i) This amount of penalty is to be deducted from the payment made on b asis of actual number of days of presence of the vehicle. No payment will be ma de for days of absence. ii) This will prevail the GeM generated deduction/LD clause. 5. The vehicle shall be maintained decently with neat and clean interiors & exte rior and the Driver shall wear proper uniform with badge. The Railway staff irres pective of his designation, nominated by the user officer shall be authorized to check for decency of the vehicle and/or the Driver and his report will be binding on the service provider. For non compliance of this condition, penalty of Rs. 50 0/- per occasion may be imposed by user officer/buyer. 6. Attendance register will be maintained by Service provider and will be kept u pto date. 7. The Authorized signatory for signing the certificate that the hired vehicle was available for the period and services were satisfactory will be the actual user off icer of the service. 8. The contractor shall be responsible for providing vehicles at any point of time in day or night even at short notice during any urgency /emergency. Drivers sho uld have live mobile phone connection so that they are contactable whenever r equired. Penalty as per para 4 will be imposed in case of failure. 9. The Railway has liberty to terminate the contract with the service provider no

rmally with one-month’s notice without assigning any reason. However, in case service provider wants to terminate his services, he will serve 03 months advan ce written notice. 10. As working of Railways is 24 x 7, therefore driver may be called at any time . The payment for extra hour chares will be made as per clause of GeM SLA. 11. The vehicle is to be parked at user officer’s premises or office premises bas ed on the instruction of the user officer and keys of the vehicle to be handed ov er to the user officer. 12. The vehicle should be available for any outstation duty during the contract p eriod. The toll charges, parking fee and entry taxes etc. payable locally or outst ation duty will be borne by the contractor. On production of the receipt, the amo unt will be reimbursed by Railways. 13. It should be stipulated that the vehicle to be supplied should be registered a s a Commercial vehicle with transport authority. It should have valid insurance and should meet requirements of pollution standard etc. as per provisions of Mo tor Transport Act and fulfil any other statutory obligations as applicable. Driver should possess a valid commercial driving license. 14. The contractor shall provide at his own cost proper uniform, badge and pho to identity card to the driver as per Motor Vehicle Transport Act. 15. Contractor shall be fully responsible for any repair, accident, loss, damage t o the vehicle or the driver. 16. Time of service shall be counted from the point of pick up to the point of fina l drop off and the garage hours shall not be included. 17. For the purpose of extra payment on account of extra KM running of the veh icle, total KMs run by the vehicle for 3 months’ duration shall bе considered. In case a vehicle is run for shorter KM in one month and more KM in the next mont h, total KM will be clubbed. Such clubbing shall be done for 3 months’ period. Fo r example - if a vehicle is hired for stipulated 2500 KM per month, then addition al payment for extra KM will be paid when total KM running of the vehicle is mor e than 2500 x 3=7500 KM over a period of 3 months. Counting of such 3 month s’ period will be starting from the next month of date of L.O.A. 18. This vehicle will be running in NWR territories, hence contractor shall arrang e road permit for vehicles accordingly . 19. Normally one rest per week shall be permitted to vehicle driver. However, u ser officer has the liberty to decide the day of rest in the week or collectively in concerned month as per his requirement of vehicle. 20. The vehicle deployed shall arrive at designated location of duty on time and with full tank or sufficient fuel i.e. Diesel, Petrol, CNG etc. There is no provision of allowing service, fuelling etc. in scheduled duty time. If driver does not follow this condition, penalty of Rs.500/- per occasion may be imposed by user officer. 21. Change of the regular vehicle/driver provided at the time of contract start d ate can be permitted with written permission of Buyer/user after submitting all t he documents of the vehicle/driver including MOU with vehicle owner. In case of

emergency, vehicle /driver may be changed by bidder with written permission f rom the user officer. Other vehicle/driver deployed without permission will be tr eated as absent and the penalty will be imposed. 22. The driver of the vehicle must have a working mobile number for easy conta ct by the officer. It must also have an active internet connection at all times wh ere google maps can be accessed, to navigate the shortest and/or fastest route possible avoiding traffic jams. The driver shall be reachable at all times. . 8. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file.
